remarks: Offered for the first time since it was built in 1999, this single-level 3-bedroom, 2-bath home of about 1,587 sq ft pairs 10-foot ceilings with clerestory windows for bright, open living spaces. Plantation shutters, laminate floors and a living room fireplace set a relaxed tone, with a separate dining room for gatherings. The kitchen has a skylight, Corian counters, a gas cooktop, built-in wall oven and microwave, and a breakfast nook with built-in cabinetry and a slider to the patio. The primary suite opens to the backyard and includes a dual vanity, soaking tub and separate shower. Indoor laundry room and an attached two-car garage.
